purpose: Independent STATIC review of the sharedCPU selection diagnostic; no workload run by reviewer

checks.finding: The module, configuration and every attempt identify this as selection-only: two servers SHARE guestCPU0; rates cannot establish the dedicated-one-CPU target.
prepare recomputes the exact official42/semantic/database fingerprint for every case, pins source inventories and service binaries, and accepts only the declared corrected driver image/binary.
The runner checks actual tag-to-image IDs before loads, launches immutable IDs, verifies service binary hashes, source readiness hashes and the driver selected by PATH in both instance containers.
Both servers request and inspect CPU0, one-CPUquota,2GiB/no swap and equal defaultCpuShares0; both drivers request and inspect CPUs1,2,two-CPUquota,2GiB/no swap. Effective cgroup limits are recorded.
Even A/A receives unique left/right server and load containers and each serve.py creates an independent fresh copy of the same seed database. Each client joins only its own server network namespace.

The CLI requires baseline:baseline first and all planned A/A repeats complete before variants. Every A/A must be valid and meet frozen5% throughput and CPU-seconds imbalance limits; a failure stops variants and retains attempts.
Both warmups complete before either measurement phase begins. A two-worker barrier launches identical workloads; sameVM monotonic start/end times and maximum250ms start skew are recorded/checked.
parallel joins both measured workers, including on errors, before after/stop metrics, shutdown or database checks; valid measurement cannot overlap the other side cleanup.

Warmup and measurement HTTP/socket errors, service-controller exit, duration, committed post growth, DBquick_check, missing server logs, unhealthy/OOM containers and failed cleanup all invalidate the attempt.

Unique new output directories preserve commands, raw outputs, probes, logs and both sides. Final medians require every planned repeat valid; attempted/valid/required counts and partial_or_invalid flag expose missing/invalid repeats.
Case-to-side assignment and worker submission order reverse by repeat. Requested first/second ratios are oriented by case identity despite side reversal.
The exact frozen runner completed full --plan successfully against the nine-case suite, including newly verified combined-sqlite. This review launched no container or load.

limitations: Both services compete on one guestCPU and both clients compete on two guestCPUs. Shared scheduling, yielding, I/O and client saturation can affect relative rates; this experiment selects candidates only and cannot meet or replace the >=5% dedicatedCPU holdout protocol.
Docker exec and thread scheduling create imperfect simultaneous starts. The runner records sameVM monotonic launch times and invalidates measured start skew above its frozen bound.
Static review does not replace observing the initial A/A validation and recorded actual limits during execution.
